title: Axolotl eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water/ground shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#2b4a7a' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 64 Q10 58 12 48 Q14 40 20 44 Q24 48 24 56 Z' fill='#f48fb1'/>
  <path d='M22 64 Q12 60 13 52 Q14 46 18 48' fill='none' stroke='#f8bbd0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#f06292'/>

  <!-- body light patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='16' ry='9' fill='#f8bbd0' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- back legs -->
  <g fill='#ec407a'>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='78' rx='7' ry='4.5' transform='rotate(-12 34 78)'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='78' rx='7' ry='4.5' transform='rotate(12 64 78)'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#f8bbd0'>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='80' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-12 30 80)'/>
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='80' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(12 68 80)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- front legs -->
  <g fill='#ec407a'>
    <ellipse cx='38' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(18 38 74)'/>
    <ellipse cx='62' cy='74' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(-18 62 74)'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#f8bbd0'>
    <ellipse cx='35' cy='76' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' transform='rotate(18 35 76)'/>
    <ellipse cx='65' cy='76' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' transform='rotate(-18 65 76)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- gills left -->
  <g stroke='#ff80ab' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <path d='M36 42 Q26 32 22 28'/>
    <path d='M34 44 Q24 38 18 36'/>
    <path d='M36 46 Q26 46 20 48'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M25 31 Q23 29 22 28'/>
    <path d='M21 37 Q19 36 18 36'/>
    <path d='M23 47 Q21 47 20 48'/>
  </g>

  <!-- gills right -->
  <g stroke='#ff80ab' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'>
    <path d='M64 42 Q74 32 78 28'/>
    <path d='M66 44 Q76 38 82 36'/>
    <path d='M64 46 Q74 46 80 48'/>
  </g>
  <g stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M75 31 Q77 29 78 28'/>
    <path d='M79 37 Q81 36 82 36'/>
    <path d='M77 47 Q79 47 80 48'/>
  </g>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#f06292'/>

  <!-- face light area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f8bbd0' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='3.8' fill='#1a0a10'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='3.8' fill='#1a0a10'/>
  <circle cx='44.2' cy='41.8' r='1.5' fill='#ffd7e3'/>
  <circle cx='58.2' cy='41.8' r='1.5' fill='#ffd7e3'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8a9e' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8a9e' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- snack: small fish tail sticking out, orange treat -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#ffb74d'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffcc80'/>
    <path d='M56 54 Q61 50 60 56 Q61 62 56 58 Z' fill='#ff9800'/>
  </g>

  <!-- mouth, open around snack -->
  <path d='M42 54 Q46 59 50 57 Q54 59 58 54' fill='none' stroke='#c2185b' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M47 57 Q50 59 53 57' fill='none' stroke='#ad1457' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe082'>
    <path d='M76 60 L77 63 L80 64 L77 65 L76 68 L75 65 L72 64 L75 63 Z'/>
    <path d='M24 58 L24.8 60 L27 60.8 L24.8 61.6 L24 64 L23.2 61.6 L21 60.8 L23.2 60 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
